audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows read Vayne or Skill while every why underneath them describes Heimerdinger zoning her off the wave, and the lane is a 43.67% loss.
audit.why: The mirror (heimerdinger__vayne) landed Skill / Heimerdinger x5 / Vayne. That matches this file's own prose — whys[0..3] all describe being walled out, and spikes[0] literally cites the sub-45% win rate. Level 1 is the one coinflip stage because a single 20-mana turret is contestable.
audit.corrected: Chart: Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Vayne, proposed as matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike claimed the lane flips there; with the corrected chart the flip is at two items.
audit.why: One Blade of the Ruined King does not solve a flat 11s grenade stun plus a turret field he can rebuild on a 1s cooldown. The real flip is Final Hour's invisible Tumbles plus percent-max-HP Silver Bolts at two items.
audit.corrected: First item: buy tenacity and hunt the 11s gap. Two items: you delete him on contact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names his abilities properly, and no cooldown is given for the ability the whole lane is built around.
audit.why: H-28 G Evolution Turret is a 1s cooldown, 350 range, 20 mana — the nest comes back almost instantly, so killing turrets is not a plan. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank, 970 range, and only a DIRECT hit stuns; surrounding units are merely slowed. Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 on 11s falling to 7s. UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s and empowers the next spell.
audit.corrected: Real names and the flat-11s grenade window written in, plus the direct-hit-only stun rule.

edits.before: Heimer's turrets wall Vayne off the wave and zone her before Silver Bolts matter.
edits.after: At Level 1 his single turret costs 20 mana and Vayne can trade around it.

edits.before: At Level 5 it's even skill as Vayne's item power starts to offset the turret zone.
edits.after: At 6 UPGRADE!!! empowers the turret or grenade and makes any dive suicidal.

edits.before: With her first item and a QSS, Vayne can Tumble through the turrets and burst the squishy immobile Heimer.
edits.after: At one item the turret field still walls her out, and his 11s grenade stun still outlasts her trade window.

edits.before: This is where you start to breathe: with Blade of the Ruined King and a QSS/Mercs for his E stun, you can Tumble through the turret line, Condemn Heimer, and burst him since he's a squishy immobile mage. Kill him whenever his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: One item is not enough yet: his grenade stun is a flat 11s and the turret line still walls you off, so a dive without Mercs or QSS ends with you stunned inside it. Buy the tenacity first, then hunt the 11s gap after he throws it.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay his: the turret field walls you out, and his upgraded R turret plus E stun make any dive suicidal. Around Level 5 it edges toward even as your item power creeps up, but don't facecheck the turret line.
edits.after: Levels 2-6 stay his: the turret field walls you out, and UPGRADE!!! on a 100s cooldown empowers the next spell so any dive is suicidal. His grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — that gap is the only time to step forward.

edits.before: Your first item flips it — Blade plus a QSS for his stun let you Tumble through the turrets and burst a squishy immobile mage, and with 2+ items Final Hour kiting and %-health Silver Bolts delete him the instant you reach him.
edits.after: One item is not the flip — his 11s grenade stun still holds you off the turret line, but with 2+ items Final Hour's invisible Tumbles and %-health Silver Bolts delete a squishy immobile mage the instant you reach him.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s — step up only after it.

edits.before: Heimerdinger wastes CH-2 Grenade (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: H-28 G Evolution Turret is a 1s cooldown — he rebuilds the nest instantly.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Only a direct hit stuns; the splash just slows — dodge the centre.

notes: Every level-chart row except the last contradicted the prose sitting next to it AND a 43.67% win rate; realigned to the already-applied mirror as matched pairs. Two facts that change how the lane is played and were absent: the turret is a 1s cooldown (so trading turret kills is pointless) and the grenade only stuns on a DIRECT hit, splash is slow-only. The mirror agent left an open question about which tone hex a FAV lane should use; not applicable on this side since this lane is correctly marked HARD.
